themeDescription: Exploration, discovery, and the natural world

days.title: Where New Ideas Come From
days.learning_objective: Understanding where new ideas come from and its significance.
learning_objectives: Define creativity and identify its key components.
Apply brainstorming techniques to generate a diverse range of ideas.
Evaluate the effectiveness of different creative problem-solving approaches.

days.title: How to Think About Thinking
days.learning_objective: Understanding how to think about thinking helps us make sense of the world.
learning_objectives: Define critical thinking and its importance.
Identify common logical fallacies in arguments.
Evaluate the credibility of sources using specific criteria.
Construct well-reasoned arguments with supporting evidence.
Apply critical thinking skills to real-world scenarios.

days.title: How to Choose
days.learning_objective: Understanding how to choose helps us make sense of the world.
learning_objectives: Identify the key steps in a rational decision-making process.
Evaluate different options based on personal values and available information.
Analyze the potential consequences of various choices.
Recognize and mitigate common cognitive biases that affect decision making.

days.title: Thinking Ahead
days.learning_objective: Thinking Ahead is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Define planning and its importance in achieving goals.
Create a basic daily or weekly schedule using effective time management techniques.
Break down larger tasks into smaller, manageable steps for improved execution.

days.title: Putting Things in Order
days.learning_objective: Putting Things in Order is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Define organization and its benefits.
Identify personal organizing challenges and develop tailored solutions.
Apply practical organization techniques to various areas of life.

days.title: Paying Attention on Purpose
days.learning_objective: Purpose gives meaning and direction to life.
learning_objectives: Define "focus" and explain its importance.
Identify common distractions and develop strategies to minimize them.
Apply techniques like the Pomodoro method to improve concentration.

days.title: Keeping Going When It's Hard
days.learning_objective: Keeping Going When It's Hard is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Define persistence in simple terms.
Identify personal challenges where persistence is needed.
Apply strategies to overcome obstacles and maintain effort.

days.title: Changing When Things Change
days.learning_objective: Change is constant and inevitable in all things.
learning_objectives: Define adaptability and its importance.
Identify examples of adaptability in nature, history, and everyday life.
Develop practical strategies for adapting to changing circumstances.

days.title: Bouncing Back
days.learning_objective: Bouncing Back is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Define resilience and identify its key components.
Apply strategies for reframing negative thoughts and cultivating a positive mindset.
Develop coping mechanisms for managing stress and overcoming setbacks.

days.title: Trusting Yourself
days.learning_objective: Self-trust comes from knowing your values and capabilities.
learning_objectives: Identify and challenge negative self-talk.
Practice positive affirmations to build self-belief.
Develop strategies for overcoming fear of failure.

days.title: Knowing Who You Are
days.learning_objective: Identity encompasses our values, experiences, and sense of self.
learning_objectives: Define humility and identify its key characteristics.
Recognize the benefits of humility in personal and professional relationships.
Apply strategies to cultivate humility in daily life.

days.title: Why Truth Matters
days.learning_objective: Understanding why truth matters matters to us and the world.
learning_objectives: Define honesty and explain its importance.
Identify situations where honesty is essential.
Practice truthful communication in everyday interactions.

days.title: Being the Same When No One's Looking
days.learning_objective: Being the Same When No One's Looking is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Define integrity and explain its importance in personal and social contexts.
Identify personal values and principles that guide ethical decision-making.
Analyze real-world scenarios to apply principles of integrity and make responsible choices.
Demonstrate consistent alignment between actions and values through role-playing and discussions.

days.title: Owning What You Do
days.learning_objective: Owning What You Do is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Define responsibility and accountability in their own words.
Identify three ways to demonstrate responsibility in daily life.
Explain the benefits of taking responsibility for one's actions.

days.title: What Fair Really Means
days.learning_objective: Fairness means treating everyone with equal consideration.
learning_objectives: Define respect and identify its key components.
Demonstrate active listening skills and empathize with diverse perspectives.
Apply respectful communication techniques in various social situations.

days.title: Making Things Right
days.learning_objective: Repairing harm restores relationships and trust.
learning_objectives: Define fairness, equality, and equity.
Identify examples of unfairness in everyday situations.
Explain the importance of treating others with respect and consideration.
Develop strategies for promoting fairness and justice in their community.
Understand different perspectives on fairness.

days.title: Working Together
days.learning_objective: Collaboration combines different strengths for better outcomes.
learning_objectives: Define cooperation and its benefits in achieving shared goals.
Identify effective communication strategies for collaborative tasks.
Demonstrate the ability to compromise and resolve conflicts within a team.
Apply cooperative principles to solve problems in a group setting.

days.title: Why We Compete
days.learning_objective: Competition drives improvement and reveals our capabilities.
learning_objectives: Define compromise and explain its importance in relationships.
Identify and practice active listening skills to understand different perspectives.
Apply negotiation strategies to find mutually beneficial solutions in conflict situations.

days.title: What Leaders Actually Do
days.learning_objective: Understanding what leaders actually do reveals about our world.
learning_objectives: Define conflict and identify common causes of disagreements.
Apply active listening techniques to understand different perspectives.
Develop and practice strategies for constructive communication and compromise.

days.title: Better Together
days.learning_objective: Better Together is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify the eight planets in our Solar System in order from the Sun.
Describe at least one unique characteristic of each planet.
Explain that all planets orbit the Sun.

days.title: Finding Common Ground
days.learning_objective: Finding Common Ground is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify Mercury as the planet closest to the Sun and the smallest in our solar system.
Describe the surface features and extreme temperature variations on Mercury.
Explain Mercury's rapid orbital speed and its relative size compared to Earth and other planets.

days.title: When People Disagree
days.learning_objective: Understanding when people disagree shaped history and our lives.
learning_objectives: Explain why Venus is the hottest planet in the solar system.
Describe the composition and characteristics of Venus's atmosphere.
Compare and contrast Venus and Earth.
Identify key features of Venus's surface.

days.title: More Than No Fighting
days.learning_objective: More Than No Fighting is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify key features that make Earth unique among planets.
Describe the basic functions of Earth's major ecosystems.
Explain the importance of biodiversity for a healthy planet.

days.title: Why Humans Fight
days.learning_objective: Understanding why humans fight matters to us and the world.
learning_objectives: Identify iron oxide as the primary reason for Mars' red color.
Describe at least three significant features of the Martian landscape.
Explain the potential for past or present life on Mars.

days.title: Stories of What Happened
days.learning_objective: Stories of What Happened is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify Jupiter as the largest planet in our solar system.
Describe the Great Red Spot and its characteristics.
List at least three of Jupiter's moons and their unique features.

days.title: How Societies Form
days.learning_objective: Understanding how societies form helps us make sense of the world.
learning_objectives: Describe the composition and structure of Saturn's rings.
Identify at least three of Saturn's major moons and their unique characteristics.
Explain the causes of the dynamic weather patterns observed on Saturn.

days.title: What Makes Groups Different
days.learning_objective: Understanding what makes groups different reveals about our world.
learning_objectives: Identify Uranus as the seventh planet from the Sun.
Explain Uranus's unique axial tilt and its impact on its seasons.
Describe the composition and atmospheric characteristics of Uranus.

days.title: Why We Keep Doing Things
days.learning_objective: Understanding why we keep doing things matters to us and the world.
learning_objectives: Identify Neptune as the eighth planet from the Sun and the windiest in the solar system.
Describe the composition and atmospheric characteristics of Neptune.
Explain the causes of Neptune's high wind speeds and storms.

days.title: Better Ways of Doing Things
days.learning_objective: Better Ways of Doing Things is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify comets as icy bodies that orbit the Sun.
Explain how a comet's tail forms when it approaches the Sun.
Describe the basic composition of a comet (nucleus, coma, tail).

days.title: When Everything Changes Fast
days.learning_objective: Rapid change requires adaptation and resilience.
learning_objectives: Identify asteroids as rocky objects orbiting the Sun.
Describe the general location of the asteroid belt.
Explain the potential impact of asteroids on Earth.

days.title: How Life Changes Over Time
days.learning_objective: Time passes at a constant rate, yet feels different in different moments.
learning_objectives: Define what a meteor is and differentiate it from meteoroids and meteorites.
Explain how meteors create light in Earth's atmosphere.
Identify the origin of most meteors as debris from comets or asteroids.
